bhakta: Someone who practises bhakti; a person who is devoted to God; a devotee; a worshipper.
bhang: A traditional South Asian preparation made from the leaves and flowers of the cannabis plant, consumed in food or drink.
bharal: A blue sheep, being any species of the genus Pseudois, goatlike bovids of the Himalayas and western China with a bluish-grey coat; Himalayan blue sheep (Pseudois nayaur).
bheestie: A water carrier, as to a household or a regiment.
bhistie: Alternative form of bheestie (“a traditional water-carrier of South Asia”).
bhoot: A supernatural creature, usually the ghost of a deceased person.
